verdict.line: You lose if you facetank poke while he banks Parrrley gold uncontested, and you win if you land E (Disdain) to lock him down before he resets with W (Remove Scurvy).

brief.thesis: This is an even lane by the numbers (51.2% over 1477 games) that swings on a single mechanical duel: Gangplank's Q (Parrrley) poke versus your E (Disdain) engage. He wants to peel autos and Parrrley from max range without ever entering your Q (Corrosive Charge) threat range; you want to walk him down, bait a Parrrley, then punish the 5s cooldown window with E. Urgot actually owns the solo-kill numbers here, so aggression is rewarded, not punished.

tell.watch: Gangplank's barrels and his W charges

theirWindow.what: If you let him free-hit Parrrley off cooldown every 5s without closing distance, he out-trades you on pure poke and denies your melee-range Purge resets. Walk up through minion waves so he has to choose between farming and poking.

yourWindow.when: right after he fires Parrrley (5s cd)
yourWindow.what: The instant his Q (Parrrley) is on cooldown he has no way to disengage or punish your approach from range. Flash-less, this is your window to E (Disdain) onto him — it shields you through his auto/barrel and hurls him into your W (Purge) uptime.

start.why: Picked in 72.7% of games at 52% win rate — the extra sustain and AD let you trade into his poke without losing the wave.

boots.why: 68.2% pick rate at 50% win rate; the flat physical damage reduction directly cuts his auto-attack/Parrrley poke damage all lane.

core.why: Shreds his armor so your W (Purge) ticks and R execute threshold come online faster
The shield and tenacity let you survive the poke window before you can close with E
58.1% win rate over 203 games in this path; stacks resistances for extended side-lane skirmishes

situational.when: he builds crit or you need more active slow to stick E follow-ups
you need to close the Parrrley poke gap faster across lane
you're tired of eating slows from his barrels or poke zoning

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards landing consecutive hits once you close distance with E, amplifying the burst that follows a successful Disdain grab

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport runs a 54.7% win rate at 13.7% pick — Teleport lets you reset off his poke sustainably and still answer sieges, while Flash guarantees your E (Disdain) connects when he tries to walk away after a Parrrley.

playing.title: Force trades through minions
playing.detail: Walk up using the wave as cover so he can't free-cast Parrrley without risking a minion block; this closes the range gap he relies on.

playing.title: Punish the 5s Parrrley cooldown
playing.detail: The moment he fires Q (Parrrley), that's your 5-second window to E (Disdain) in — he has no ranged answer until it's back up.

playing.title: Track his W (Remove Scurvy) charge
playing.detail: Remove Scurvy clears CC and heals him on an 18-22s cooldown depending on rank; don't commit your all-in combo if he just used it, since your E's hurl won't convert to a kill through the heal.

playing.title: Purge in melee range only
playing.detail: W (Purge) slows you while firing, so only commit it after E has already locked him in position — never as an opener from range.

playing.title: Save R for sub-threshold picks
playing.detail: R (Fear Beyond Death) only executes below the health threshold; use it to finish extended trades, not to open them, since he can still Remove Scurvy away full HP.

playing.title: Respect Cannon Barrage after level 6
playing.detail: His R has global range and slows plus damages over time anywhere on the map — don't overextend in side lanes once he's 6, especially if you're split-pushing alone.

playing.title: Play for late-game 1v1 power
playing.detail: Your W (Purge) and R scale favorably after level 10 with Black Cleaver's armor shred online, so look to force extended skirmishes rather than quick poke trades.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, win rates, and pick rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical breakdown of cooldown windows and trade patterns is my own tactical read, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit by Gangplank’s Grasp of the Undying – (Q). Pay attention to his barrels when fighting him while making sure [E] hits him.
